purpose: Teach: インフラ/漁港/眠れる/疲労/行列/砂漠/丘/霧

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、街の、本気で、絶対、インフラ、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、お洒落と思うわ
lines.en: Sho, I really do think the town infrastructure is stylish, you know?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy observation. Warm affection settling into the words. Pace unhurried, like she's noticing something out loud to him rather than at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、海の、絶対、漁港、絶対、見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to see the fishing port by the sea someday.
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath the surface. Not demanding — more like sharing something he's been thinking about. Careful, hopeful. The words land gently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、夜、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、眠れる、絶対、ように、絶対、心がけてるわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I make sure to sleep properly at night, you know? I really do try.
lines.style: Reassuring without being performed. Like she's letting him in on something small and true about how she takes care of herself. Steady, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、勉強の、絶対、疲労、絶対、たまったみたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think I've built up a lot of tiredness from studying.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact admission with a thread of vulnerability underneath. Not complaining — observing. Small, quiet voice. Like he's naming something he's noticed about himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、お祭りの、絶対、行列、絶対、並ぼうね、翔くん
lines.en: Let's stand in line together at the festival, Sho, okay?
lines.style: Invitation wrapped in gentle certainty. Like she's already imagining it. Warm, present, reaching toward him slightly. The 'let's' carries the weight of wanting him there.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、絵本で、絶対、砂漠、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a desert once in a picture book.
lines.style: Small wonder in the voice. Sharing something discovered. Pace unhurried, like he's turning the memory over. Genuine curiosity, not performing excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、丘、絶対、登ってみたいね、翔くん
lines.en: I'd really like to climb a hill with you someday, Sho.
lines.style: Tender wish spoken aloud. Like she's letting him know what she's been thinking about. Pace gentle, open. The kind of thing you say when you mean it and don't need agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、今朝、絶対、霧、絶対、で、絶対、何も見えなかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, this morning there was so much mist I couldn't see anything.
lines.style: Simple observation delivered with quiet fascination. Like he's still sitting with the strangeness of it. Pace unhurried. Small voice, but present. No urgency — just noticing.
